name: arcgis-ai-demo-starter
description: Starter template for ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript demos with an AI assistant and custom agents.

comments.arcgis-versions: Pinned to the 5.0.x line this template was built and tested against. The ArcGIS packages must move together, and 5.2.x restructured @arcgis/ai-orchestrator out of ai-components' dependencies, which breaks the optimizeDeps entry in vite.config.ts. Upgrade deliberately: bump all four, check Esri's version matrix, then run the app.
